title: Packed pointer layout omitted from the centralized target description during the pin rebase
summary: The local compiler-pin rebase omitted packed-pointer layout p3:24:8 from the centralized target description. Porting the existing 0006 backend declaration to TargetParser repairs the paired Clang/backend layout contract. The retained preprocessed C input fails on the preserved intermediate rebase compiler and passes on the identified candidate; this is local integration work, not an upstream defect discovery.

The new pin uses the centralized layout in MachineFunction creation and Clang ABI verification. The in-progress rebase dropped the old backend declaration without porting its p3 field.

prior_work.decision: A new record documents the distinct local integration regression introduced by this unpublished rebase. The older work implements packed pointers correctly in the old backend location and has no canonical record for this mismatched centralized description. Do not submit a duplicate upstream report.

resolution.change: patches/llvm-mos/0006-320-packed24.patch: centralized TargetDataLayout p3 declaration and bootstrap include filter
resolution.causal_explanation: Upstream now obtains the backend layout from Triple::computeDataLayout in TargetParser. The packed pointer declaration remained in Clang while the old MOS-specific layout hunk no longer applied. Restoring p3:24:8 in the shared declaration makes both descriptions agree; the frontend and regression input remain unchanged.
resolution.trigger_check: Both baseline.ll and candidate.ll retain p3:24:8. The same retained arith.i and target/configuration reject object generation on the baseline and pass on the candidate. No frontend transformation masks the backend guard. This regression validates object generation; no runtime claim.
